lugs.title: Scout worktree-no-uncommitted broke: git status shows no changed or untracked files

attempts.summary: No change needed: worktree-no-uncommitted already prints PASS and exits 0 here, since B-028 made the scout ignore the lug store files.
attempts.no_code: The scout's fix landed earlier in B-028 (410b2c5). The check passes on this branch with no file change.
attempts.evidence: Ran `python3 -B .wheel/hooks/scouts.py run worktree-no-uncommitted`. It printed 'PASS worktree-no-uncommitted' and 'PASS c1: git status shows no changed or untracked files (the wheel's own lug store files are ignored)'. That is the scout's only check. A second run through `bash -c` with output discarded gave exit=0. `git status --short` was empty afterwards, so the run left no residue and I saw no sign of cache residue. I did not read the scout's source or the B-028 tests/scout_lugstore.sh test, so I did not check that the lug-store ignore is correct. I did not check any of the listed traps be
